parsed.title: Overlap slow LLM calls with fast embedding work via background threads
parsed.body: Indexing was bottlenecked by Claude's ~5s/batch latency while embeddings only take ~50ms, so embedding batch N now runs in a background thread while Claude processes batch N+1, overlapping the two instead of running them sequentially. The same idea applies to search: the query embedding is computed in a background thread while search context setup happens concurrently. The key insight is to identify which stage is the true bottleneck and parallelize the cheap stage against it rather than optimizing the cheap stage in isolation.

parsed.title: Two-pass semantic search avoids wasted deserialization
parsed.body: Semantic search previously loaded and deserialized full rows (including JSON file arrays and strings) for every indexed item just to compute cosine similarity and discard most of them. The fix splits search into two passes: first score all (id, embedding) pairs cheaply, then only load and deserialize full rows for the top-N candidates. This trades a bit of complexity for avoiding unnecessary allocation/deserialization work on rows that will never be returned.

subject: Add diwa update — upgrades binary and refreshes all registered repos

parsed.title: Central repo manifest enables fleet-wide updates via `diwa update`
parsed.body: To let a single `diwa update` command propagate improved hook scripts, extraction prompts, and reflection criteria to every repo a user has set up, diwa needed a persistent registry of which repos are managed. `diwa init` now writes an entry to ~/.diwa/repos.json and `diwa uninit` removes it, making the manifest the source of truth for which repos to upgrade/reindex. This decouples 'improving diwa' from 'manually re-running setup in every repo', solving the problem of stale hooks/prompts across multiple projects.

parsed.title: Add optional dynamic loading of ONNX Runtime to avoid glibc coupling
parsed.body: Static linking against ONNX Runtime ties the binary to the glibc version it was built against, causing failures on systems with older or different glibc. Adding a load-dynamic feature flag that uses dlopen via fastembed's ort-load-dynamic lets users opt into runtime loading of the shared library instead, trading build simplicity for portability. Keeping it as an opt-in feature (not default) preserves the simpler static-link path for most users.

The fix removes migrate from post_install entirely and instead relies on the existing auto_migrate_if_needed path that runs on the user's next diwa invocation, outside the sandbox where writes succeed, with a caveats message explaining the deferred migration.

subject: Multi-account CF ingress: fetch routes for all accounts in config

parsed.title: Support multi-account Cloudflare ingress sync by deriving account_ids from tunnel tokens
parsed.body: The original sync only queried a single account via `cloudflared tunnel list`, which missed tunnels belonging to other accounts configured in the same setup. The fix decodes each configured tunnel's base64 token to extract its account_id, then fetches ingress routes per-account, trying all available API credentials (cert.pem and cf_api_token) against each one. This generalizes the tool to work correctly for users managing tunnels across multiple Cloudflare accounts instead of assuming a single-account context.
